items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-08-23
items.q: He and Fast Life Eddie, Treacherous Slim, Big Dipper. I'm trying to think of some of the guys, the Whispering Boots. All those guys were big-time gamblers.

ctx.x: Did that cause the demise of that club? Because I don't think it...

I don't think so. No. No. I don't think it caused the demise of the club. I think things started changing with... You see, Club Desire was down in the Ninth Ward. But you had the Dewdrop, the Robin Hood, and all of these Johnny-come-lately clubs, which were just beginning to hit their stride to develop new entertainment. Then, like I said, you had the Coliseum Arena, which was in the central part of the city. You had the ILA Club, which was in the French Quarter. You had all of these things jumping against…
How do you see the difference? Is there any difference between rhythm and blues and rock and roll? I mean, did you see a difference?
